text:
Maya: Quick design pass on the first-run onboarding banner — want to discuss CTA hierarchy, micro-animation timing, and sample project selection logic. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/onboard-banner

Sam: Re: CTA hierarchy — lean Primary = "Create sample project", Secondary = "Browse templates". "Get started" is ambiguous. :thumbsup:

Dina: Agree with CTAs. Accessibility note: animation must respect prefers-reduced-motion and focus order needs CTA before dismiss button. Suggest aria-label: "Start with a sample project".

Liam: Timing notes: entrance 350ms, bounce 170ms felt smooth in perf tests. 200ms caused a noticeable layout shift. Also recommend only animate after 200ms of no-scroll so we don't trigger mid-scroll.

Maya: Good call. Also tradeoff: inline sample options vs modal. Inline shows examples immediately but can push content down. Thoughts?

Sam: Inline + collapsed state could work — show top 3 samples in a horizontal strip, with a "Show more" to expand. Keeps initial frame stable.

Jaya: Copy suggestion: change "Try a sample project" -> "Try a sample app" (shorter). Add helper microcopy under CTA: "You can change this later" to lower friction.

design-bot: A/B test plan: Variant A = tooltip helper on hover, Variant B = persistent hint under CTA. Start with 1% rollout for metrics.

aria-checker: Quick a11y callout: current banner text contrast measures ~3.8:1. For small text we need >=4.5:1. Either darken text or increase weight/size.

Maya: Ack. I'll update the Figma to hit 4.6:1, add prefers-reduced-motion, and prototype inline collapsed samples + primary CTA "Create sample project". Will post updated link by EOD.

Sam: Awesome — pinging @product for copy review: @Arjun @Priya

Maya: Also wondering about keyboard nav: if samples expand, focus should land on first sample card; escape collapses. Adding to the interaction spec.

Dina: Sounds good. I can add a quick keyboard nav test to the accessibility checklist for the PR.

Liam: If we ship inline, let's add telemetry events: banner_shown, sample_opened, sample_launched, banner_dismissed. Keep names consistent with analytics schema.

Maya: Noted. I'll include telemetry keys in the figma notes. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
